DeSMòS (Descriptive Semantic Model for Structured Texts)

https://w3id.org/desmos/
version info
Version 1.2.0
version
https://w3id.org/desmos/v1.2.0
prior version
https://zenodo.org/records/19610250/files/desmos.owl
title
DeSMòS (Descriptive Semantic Model for Structured Texts)
description
DeSMòS (Descriptive Semantic Model for Structured Texts) is an OWL 2 ontology for the formal representation of literary constraints as text-generative procedures, with particular reference to the Oulipian tradition. The model treats constraints as conceptual entities distinct from works and their bibliographic realisations, represented through LRMoo, and describes their use in expression creation events, distinguishing the procedure from both the creative process and the resulting text. Constrained rewriting is represented through derivation and intertextual relations between expressions, allowing the identification of the textual passages involved. The typological characterisation distinguishes formal and semantic constraints, with a specific category for visual constraints, and describes the constrained units, procedural operations, and origins through SKOS controlled vocabularies. The model also supports the documentation of constraint use through intratextual evidence and paratextual statements, whether peritextual or epitextual, distinguishing responsibility for such statements from responsibility for textual creation. Through the reuse of and alignment with CIDOC CRM, LRMoo, PROV-O, SKOS, INTRO, Dublin Core Terms, and Schema.org, DeSMòS supports the description, comparative analysis, and SPARQL querying of constrained writing practices across heterogeneous corpora.
comment
DeSMòS adopts an "alignment-by-reference" pattern to keep the ontology lightweight and reasoner-friendly.

comment
In DeSMòS, the class is used to define individual literary constraints and analytical categories within an organized knowledge system. The properties that can be used with this class are desmos:coarserThan, desmos:constrainsFormalUnit, desmos:constrainsSemanticUnit, desmos:constraintOrigin, desmos:finerThan, desmos:involvesOperation, skos:broader, skos:closeMatch, skos:exactMatch, skos:inScheme, skos:narrower and skos:related.

E1 CRM Entity
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/E1_CRM_Entity

comment
In DeSMòS, E1 CRM Entity is the root of the CIDOC CRM hierarchy and is referenced as the original domain or range of P2 has type, P3 has note, P67 refers to and P129 is about. E7 Activity, E39 Actor and E70 Thing are declared as its direct subclasses, abbreviating the official chains through E5 Event and E77 Persistent Item.

E28 Conceptual Object
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/E28_Conceptual_Object

comment
In DeSMòS, E28 Conceptual Object is the common superclass of the non-material entities in the model: through E89 Propositional Object and E90 Symbolic Object it subsumes information objects (works, expressions, linguistic objects, passages); it is also the direct superclass of E55 Type, desmos:TextualFeature and intro:INT3_Interrelation (the reified intertextual relations), as well as of intro:INT2_ActualizationOfFeature and intro:INT6_Architext, which are referenced only in the original ranges of R12 and R13.
en
is defined by
http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/
is sub class of
E70 Thingc
is super class of
E55 Typec,
E89 Propositional Objectc,
E90 Symbolic Objectc,
Textual featurec,
INT3 Interrelationc,
INT2 Actualization of Featurec,
INT6 Architextc
label
E28 Conceptual Object
en

@prefix : <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
@prefix crm: <http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

: {
    crm:E28_Conceptual_Object a owl:Class ;
        rdfs:label "E28 Conceptual Object"@en,
            "E28 Oggetto Concettuale"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "In DeSMòS, E28 Conceptual Object is the common superclass of the non-material entities in the model: through E89 Propositional Object and E90 Symbolic Object it subsumes information objects (works, expressions, linguistic objects, passages); it is also the direct superclass of E55 Type, desmos:TextualFeature and intro:INT3_Interrelation (the reified intertextual relations), as well as of intro:INT2_ActualizationOfFeature and intro:INT6_Architext, which are referenced only in the original ranges of R12 and R13."@en,
            "In DeSMòS, E28 Conceptual Object è la superclasse comune delle entità non materiali del modello: attraverso E89 Propositional Object ed E90 Symbolic Object comprende gli oggetti informativi (opere, espressioni, oggetti linguistici, passaggi); è inoltre superclasse diretta di E55 Type, desmos:TextualFeature e intro:INT3_Interrelation (le relazioni intertestuali reificate), nonché di intro:INT2_ActualizationOfFeature e intro:INT6_Architext, referenziate solo nei range originali di R12 e R13."@it ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy crm: ;
        rdfs:subClassOf crm:E70_Thing .
}

E33 Linguistic Object
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/E33_Linguistic_Object

comment
In DeSMòS, E33 Linguistic Object is used to identify paratextual passages (epitextual or peritextual) in which the author or editor of the volume declares the use of a literary constraint. The properties that can be used with this class are crm:P129_is_about, crm:P3_has_note, crm:P67_refers_to and prov:wasAttributedTo.
en
is defined by
http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/
is sub class of
E73 Information Objectc
label
E33 Linguistic Object
en

    crm:E33_Linguistic_Object a owl:Class ;
        rdfs:label "E33 Linguistic Object"@en,
            "E33 Oggetto Linguistico"@it ;

The properties that can be used with this class are crm:P129_is_about, crm:P3_has_note, crm:P67_refers_to and prov:wasAttributedTo."@en,
            "In DeSMòS, E33 Linguistic Object è utilizzata per identificare passaggi paratestuali (epitestuali o peritestuali) nei quali l'autore o il curatore del volume dichiara l'utilizzo di una costrizione letteraria. E55 Type
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/E55_Type

comment
In DeSMòS, E55 Type is used for two kinds of controlled types: the expressive forms of works (prose, poetry, visual poetry, visual art, music), assigned to expressions via P2 has type, and, through the INTRO subclass INT11 Type of Interrelation, intertextual relation types such as hypertextuality, assigned via R19 has type. The properties that can be used with this class are skos:exactMatch and skos:inScheme.
en

http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/
is in domain of
P2i is type ofop
is in range of
P2 has typeop
is sub class of

is super class of
INT11 Type of Interrelationc
label
E55 Type
en

        rdfs:label "E55 Type"@en,
            "E55 Tipo"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "In DeSMòS, E55 Type is used for two kinds of controlled types: the expressive forms of works (prose, poetry, visual poetry, visual art, music), assigned to expressions via P2 has type, and, through the INTRO subclass INT11 Type of Interrelation, intertextual relation types such as hypertextuality, assigned via R19 has type. The properties that can be used with this class are skos:exactMatch and skos:inScheme."@en,
            "In DeSMòS, E55 Type è utilizzata per due ordini di tipi controllati: le forme espressive delle opere (prosa, poesia, poesia visiva, arte visiva, musica), assegnate alle espressioni mediante P2 has type, e, attraverso la sottoclasse INTRO INT11 Type of Interrelation, i tipi di relazione intertestuale come l'ipertestualità, assegnati mediante R19 has type. }

E89 Propositional Object
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/E89_Propositional_Object

comment
This class comprises entities that exist as sets of characteristics or properties rather than as physical objects. In DeSMòS, it represents abstract entities such as works and, through E73 Information Object, expressions, declarations and literary constraints. Intertextual relations (intro:INT3_Interrelation) are not included, being a direct subclass of E28 Conceptual Object.
en

Intertextual relations (intro:INT3_Interrelation) are not included, being a direct subclass of E28 Conceptual Object."@en,

E90 Symbolic Object
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/E90_Symbolic_Object

comment
In DeSMòS, E90 Symbolic Object is referenced as the original range of R15 has fragment: the peritextual statements (E33 Linguistic Object) linked to an expression through R15 are symbolic objects via E73 Information Object. It is the superclass of E73 Information Object and, in INTRO, of INT1 Passage and INT16 Segment.

c

IRI: http://iflastandards.info/ns/lrm/lrmoo/F2_Expression

comment
In DeSMòS, F2 Expression is used to represent the textual realisation of a work, on which literary constraints and relations to other texts are documented. The properties that can be used with this class are crm:P130_shows_features_of, crm:P148_has_component, crm:P2_has_type, lrmoo:R15_has_fragment, lrmoo:R4i_is_embodied_in and lrmoo:R76_is_derivative_of.

comment
A constraint that operates primarily at the level of the signifier. The properties that can be used with this class are desmos:constrainsFormalUnit, desmos:constraintOrigin, desmos:involvesOperation, skos:broader, skos:closeMatch, skos:inScheme, skos:narrower and skos:related.

: {
    :FormalConstraint a owl:Class ;
        rdfs:label "Formal constraint"@en,
            "Costrizione formale"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "A constraint that operates primarily at the level of the signifier. The properties that can be used with this class are desmos:constrainsFormalUnit, desmos:constraintOrigin, desmos:involvesOperation, skos:broader, skos:closeMatch, skos:inScheme, skos:narrower and skos:related."@en,
            "Costrizione che interviene prioritariamente sul significante. Le proprietà che possono essere usate con questa classe sono desmos:constrainsFormalUnit, desmos:constraintOrigin, desmos:involvesOperation, skos:broader, skos:closeMatch, skos:inScheme, skos:narrower e skos:related."@it ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy : ;
        rdfs:subClassOf :LiteraryConstraint ;
        owl:disjointWith :SemanticConstraint .
}

INT21 Text Passage
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/lso/intro/beta202506#INT21_TextPassage

comment
In DeSMòS, INT21 Text Passage is used to represent an identifiable textual portion of an expression, particularly when documenting passages involved in an intertextual relation. The properties that can be used with this class are intro:R30i_isTextPassageOf and intro:R44_hasWording.

IRI: https://w3id.org/lso/intro/beta202506#INT31_IntertextualRelation

comment
In DeSMòS, INT31 Intertextual Relation is used to represent an intertextual relation between texts or their passages as an independent entity, specifying the entities involved and the relation type. The properties that can be used with this class are intro:R12_hasReferredToEntity, intro:R13_hasReferringEntity and intro:R19_hasType.

: {
    :LiteraryConstraint a owl:Class ;
        rdfs:label "Literary constraint"@en,

            "Procedura formale o semantica che interviene nel processo di generazione testuale (F28 Expression Creation). La sua presenza può essere documentata attraverso evidenze oggettive (TextualFeature) o dichiarazioni paratestuali (E33 Linguistic Object)."@it ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy : ;
        rdfs:subClassOf crm:E29_Design_or_Procedure,
            skos:Concept .
}

Textual feature
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/desmos/TextualFeature

comment
An observable feature of a textual expression that may indicate the presence of a literary constraint. In DeSMòS it is treated as intratextual evidence: a textual trace supporting the identification of a constraint, without implying necessity or sufficiency by itself. The properties that can be used with this class are crm:P3_has_note, desmos:isFeatureOf and desmos:revealsConstraint.

: {

        rdfs:label "Textual feature"@en,
            "Caratteristica testuale"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "An observable feature of a textual expression that may indicate the presence of a literary constraint. In DeSMòS it is treated as intratextual evidence: a textual trace supporting the identification of a constraint, without implying necessity or sufficiency by itself. The properties that can be used with this class are crm:P3_has_note, desmos:isFeatureOf and desmos:revealsConstraint."@en,
            "Caratteristica osservabile di un'espressione testuale che può indicare la presenza di una costrizione letteraria. In DeSMòS è intesa come evidenza intratestuale: una traccia testuale che supporta l’identificazione della costrizione, senza implicare di per sé sufficienza o necessità. Le proprietà che possono essere usate con questa classe sono crm:P3_has_note, desmos:isFeatureOf e desmos:revealsConstraint."@it ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy : ;
        rdfs:subClassOf crm:E28_Conceptual_Object .
}

c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/desmos/VisualConstraint

comment
Constraint that intervenes on the visual or typographic arrangement of the text, where the spatial layout of letters/words on the page is itself part of the rule. The properties that can be used with this class are desmos:constrainsFormalUnit, desmos:constraintOrigin, desmos:involvesOperation, skos:closeMatch, skos:inScheme and skos:related.

: {
    :VisualConstraint a owl:Class ;
        rdfs:label "Visual constraint"@en,
            "Costrizione visiva"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "Constraint that intervenes on the visual or typographic arrangement of the text, where the spatial layout of letters/words on the page is itself part of the rule. The properties that can be used with this class are desmos:constrainsFormalUnit, desmos:constraintOrigin, desmos:involvesOperation, skos:closeMatch, skos:inScheme and skos:related."@en,
            "Costrizione che interviene sulla disposizione visiva o tipografica del testo, in cui l'impaginazione spaziale di lettere/parole sulla pagina è essa stessa parte della regola. Le proprietà che possono essere usate con questa classe sono desmos:constrainsFormalUnit, desmos:constraintOrigin, desmos:involvesOperation, skos:closeMatch, skos:inScheme e skos:related."@it ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy : ;
        rdfs:subClassOf :FormalConstraint .
}

        rdfs:isDefinedBy skos: ;
        rdfs:range skos:Concept .

@prefix : <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .

: {
    skos:hasTopConcept a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:label "has top concept"@en,
            "ha concetto principale"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "In DeSMòS, it relates a concept scheme to the concepts that are its main hierarchical entry points. The original property has domain skos:ConceptScheme and range skos:Concept. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain skos:ConceptScheme and range skos:Concept."@en,

        rdfs:domain skos:ConceptScheme ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy skos: ;
        rdfs:range skos:Concept ;
        owl:inverseOf skos:topConceptOf .
}

: {
    crm:P129_is_about a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:label "P129 is about"@en,
            "P129 verte su"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "In DeSMòS, it states that a declaration (linguistic object) has a literary constraint as its subject. The original property has domain crm:E89_Propositional_Object and range crm:E1_CRM_Entity. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain crm:E33_Linguistic_Object and range desmos:LiteraryConstraint."@en,
            "In DeSMòS indica che una dichiarazione (oggetto linguistico) ha come argomento una costrizione letteraria. In DeSMòS la stessa proprietà ha come domain crm:E33_Linguistic_Object e come range desmos:LiteraryConstraint."@it ;
        rdfs:domain crm:E89_Propositional_Object ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy crm: ;
        rdfs:range crm:E1_CRM_Entity ;
        owl:inverseOf crm:P129i_is_subject_of .
}

P130 shows features of
op

back to ToC or Object Property ToC

IRI: http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/P130_shows_features_of

comment
In DeSMòS, it documents a looser link between expressions than R76 is derivative of: the expression shows features of a source (lexical, onomastic, phraseological, thematic, narrative or, for non-textual sources, of tempo and pacing) without deriving its content or establishing an INTRO intertextual relation. The original property has domain crm:E70_Thing and range crm:E70_Thing. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression and range lrmoo:F2_Expression.
en
domain
E70 Thingc
range

@prefix : <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
@prefix crm: <http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

: {
    crm:P130_shows_features_of a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:label "P130 shows features of"@en,
            "P130 presenta caratteristiche di"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "In DeSMòS, it documents a looser link between expressions than R76 is derivative of: the expression shows features of a source (lexical, onomastic, phraseological, thematic, narrative or, for non-textual sources, of tempo and pacing) without deriving its content or establishing an INTRO intertextual relation. The original property has domain crm:E70_Thing and range crm:E70_Thing. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression and range lrmoo:F2_Expression."@en,
            "In DeSMòS documenta un legame tra espressioni più blando di R76 is derivative of: l'espressione presenta tratti di una fonte (lessicali, onomastici, fraseologici, tematici, narrativi o, per fonti non testuali, di andamento) senza derivarne il contenuto né instaurare una relazione intertestuale INTRO. La proprietà originale ha come domain crm:E70_Thing e come range crm:E70_Thing. In DeSMòS la stessa proprietà ha come domain lrmoo:F2_Expression e come range lrmoo:F2_Expression."@it ;
        rdfs:domain crm:E70_Thing ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy crm: ;
        rdfs:range crm:E70_Thing ;
        owl:inverseOf crm:P130i_features_are_also_found_on .
}

    crm:P14_carried_out_by a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:label "P14 carried out by"@en,
            "P14 eseguito da"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "In DeSMòS, it relates an expression creation event to its author or authors. The original property has domain crm:E7_Activity and range crm:E39_Actor. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain lrmoo:F28_Expression_Creation and range crm:E39_Actor."@en,
            "In DeSMòS collega un evento di creazione dell'espressione al suo autore o ai suoi autori. La proprietà originale ha come domain crm:E7_Activity e come range crm:E39_Actor. In DeSMòS la stessa proprietà ha come domain lrmoo:F28_Expression_Creation e come range crm:E39_Actor."@it ;
        rdfs:domain crm:E7_Activity ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy crm: ;
        rdfs:range crm:E39_Actor ;
        owl:inverseOf crm:P14i_performed .
}

IRI: http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/P148_has_component

comment
In DeSMòS, it decomposes complex expressions and manifestations into their components. The original property has domain crm:E89_Propositional_Object and range crm:E89_Propositional_Object. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression (between expressions) or lrmoo:F3_Manifestation (between manifestations) and range lrmoo:F2_Expression or lrmoo:F3_Manifestation respectively.

@prefix : <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
@prefix crm: <http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

: {
    crm:P148_has_component a owl:ObjectProperty,
            owl:TransitiveProperty ;
        rdfs:label "P148 has component"@en,
            "P148 ha componente"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "In DeSMòS, it decomposes complex expressions and manifestations into their components. The original property has domain crm:E89_Propositional_Object and range crm:E89_Propositional_Object. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression (between expressions) or lrmoo:F3_Manifestation (between manifestations) and range lrmoo:F2_Expression or lrmoo:F3_Manifestation respectively."@en,
            "In DeSMòS articola espressioni e manifestazioni complesse nelle rispettive componenti. La proprietà originale ha come domain crm:E89_Propositional_Object e come range crm:E89_Propositional_Object. In DeSMòS la stessa proprietà ha come domain lrmoo:F2_Expression (tra espressioni) o lrmoo:F3_Manifestation (tra manifestazioni) e come range rispettivamente lrmoo:F2_Expression o lrmoo:F3_Manifestation."@it ;
        rdfs:domain crm:E89_Propositional_Object ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy crm: ;
        rdfs:range crm:E89_Propositional_Object ;
        owl:inverseOf crm:P148i_is_component_of .
}

R12 has referred to entity
op

back to ToC or Object Property ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/lso/intro/beta202506#R12_hasReferredToEntity

comment
In DeSMòS, it identifies the hypotextual entity of an intertextual relation: the whole expression or, when the relation can be localised, a specific passage of the hypotext. The original property has domain intro:INT3_Interrelation and range the union of lrmoo:F1_Work, crm:E73_Information_Object, intro:INT1_Passage, intro:INT2_ActualizationOfFeature and intro:INT6_Architext. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain intro:INT31_IntertextualRelation and range lrmoo:F2_Expression or intro:INT21_TextPassage.
en
domain
INT3 Interrelationc
range

)

R13i is referring entity of
op

back to ToC or Object Property ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/lso/intro/beta202506#R13i_isReferringEntity

comment
Inverse of R13 has referring entity: in DeSMòS, it relates a hypertextual entity (expression or passage) to the intertextual relation in which it is the referring entity. The original property has domain the union of lrmoo:F1_Work, crm:E73_Information_Object, intro:INT1_Passage, intro:INT2_ActualizationOfFeature and intro:INT6_Architext and range intro:INT3_Interrelation. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression or intro:INT21_TextPassage and range intro:INT31_IntertextualRelation.
en

R15 has fragment
op

back to ToC or Object Property ToC

IRI: http://iflastandards.info/ns/lrm/lrmoo/R15_has_fragment

comment
In DeSMòS, it relates an expression to the peritextual declaration contained in the same publication, which is a fragment of it and documents the use of a constraint. The original property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression and range crm:E90_Symbolic_Object. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression and range crm:E33_Linguistic_Object.
en

range
E90 Symbolic Objectc

is inverse of

label
R15 has fragment
en

@prefix : <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
@prefix crm: <http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/> .
@prefix lrmoo: <http://iflastandards.info/ns/lrm/lrmoo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

: {
    lrmoo:R15_has_fragment a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:label "R15 has fragment"@en,
            "R15 ha frammento"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "In DeSMòS, it relates an expression to the peritextual declaration contained in the same publication, which is a fragment of it and documents the use of a constraint. The original property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression and range crm:E90_Symbolic_Object. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression and range crm:E33_Linguistic_Object."@en,
            "In DeSMòS collega un'espressione alla dichiarazione peritestuale contenuta nella stessa pubblicazione, che ne è un frammento e documenta l'impiego di una costrizione. La proprietà originale ha come domain lrmoo:F2_Expression e come range crm:E90_Symbolic_Object. In DeSMòS la stessa proprietà ha come domain lrmoo:F2_Expression e come range crm:E33_Linguistic_Object."@it ;
        rdfs:domain lrmoo:F2_Expression ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy lrmoo: ;
        rdfs:range crm:E90_Symbolic_Object ;
        owl:inverseOf lrmoo:R15i_is_fragment_of .
}

In DeSMòS, it relates an expression to a textual passage selected within it, when an intertextual relation concerns specific portions of the text. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression and range intro:INT21_TextPassage.

@prefix : <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
@prefix crm: <http://www.cidoc-crm.org/cidoc-crm/> .

@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

: {
    lrmoo:R76_is_derivative_of a owl:ObjectProperty ;
        rdfs:label "R76 is derivative of"@en,
            "R76 è derivato di"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "In DeSMòS, it states that an expression derives from another expression used as a source in its creation. The original property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression and range lrmoo:F2_Expression. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain lrmoo:F2_Expression and range lrmoo:F2_Expression."@en,
            "In DeSMòS indica che un'espressione deriva da un'altra espressione assunta come fonte nella sua creazione. La proprietà originale ha come domain lrmoo:F2_Expression e come range lrmoo:F2_Expression. In DeSMòS la stessa proprietà ha come domain lrmoo:F2_Expression e come range lrmoo:F2_Expression."@it ;
        rdfs:domain lrmoo:F2_Expression ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy lrmoo: ;
        rdfs:range lrmoo:F2_Expression ;
        rdfs:subPropertyOf crm:P130_shows_features_of ;
        owl:inverseOf lrmoo:R76i_has_derivative .
}

In DeSMòS, the same property has domain skos:Concept and range skos:Concept.

@prefix : <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .

: {
    skos:related a owl:ObjectProperty,
            owl:SymmetricProperty ;
        rdfs:label "related"@en,
            "correlato"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "In DeSMòS, it expresses non-hierarchical associations between concepts of the controlled vocabularies. The original property has domain skos:Concept (inherited from skos:semanticRelation) and range skos:Concept (inherited from skos:semanticRelation). In DeSMòS, the same property has domain skos:Concept and range skos:Concept."@en,
            "In DeSMòS esprime associazioni semantiche non gerarchiche tra concetti dei vocabolari controllati. La proprietà originale ha come domain skos:Concept (ereditato da skos:semanticRelation) e come range skos:Concept (ereditato da skos:semanticRelation). In DeSMòS la stessa proprietà ha come domain skos:Concept e come range skos:Concept."@it ;

        rdfs:label "was attributed to"@en,
            "è stato attribuito a"@it ;
        rdfs:comment "In DeSMòS, it attributes a declaration (linguistic object) about a constraint to the agent responsible for it. The original property has domain prov:Entity and range prov:Agent. In DeSMòS, the same property has domain crm:E33_Linguistic_Object and range crm:E39_Actor (also prov:Agent)."@en,

        rdfs:isDefinedBy prov: ;
        rdfs:range prov:Agent .
}

}

Hypertextuality
ni

back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: https://w3id.org/desmos/hypertextuality

is defined by
https://w3id.org/desmos/
label
Hypertextuality
en
type
INT15 Intertextuality in Intertextuality Theoriesc
definition
Type of intertextual relation, in the Genettian sense, designating any relationship of derivation linking a later text (the hypertext) to an earlier one (the hypotext) upon which it is grafted in a manner that is not that of commentary; the derivation may proceed by transformation (as in parody) or by imitation (as in pastiche).
en
preferred label
Hypertextuality
en
scope note
Used as the object of intro:R19_hasType to qualify instances of intro:INT31_IntertextualRelation as Genettian hypertextual relations.
en
source
9782020061162

@prefix : <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
@prefix dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> .
@prefix intro: <https://w3id.org/lso/intro/beta202506#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .

: {
    :hypertextuality a owl:NamedIndividual,
            intro:INT15_IntertextualityInIntertextualityTheories ;
        rdfs:label "Hypertextuality"@en,
            "Ipertestualità"@it ;
        dcterms:source <https://www.worldcat.org/isbn/9782020061162> ;
        rdfs:isDefinedBy : ;
        skos:definition "Type of intertextual relation, in the Genettian sense, designating any relationship of derivation linking a later text (the hypertext) to an earlier one (the hypotext) upon which it is grafted in a manner that is not that of commentary; the derivation may proceed by transformation (as in parody) or by imitation (as in pastiche)."@en,
            "Tipo di relazione intertestuale, nell'accezione genettiana, che designa qualsiasi rapporto di derivazione che collega un testo posteriore (l'ipertesto) ad un testo anteriore (l'ipotesto) sul quale esso si innesta in modo non commentativo; la derivazione può realizzarsi per trasformazione (come nella parodia) o per imitazione (come nel pastiche)."@it ;
        skos:prefLabel "Hypertextuality"@en,
            "Ipertestualità"@it ;
        skos:scopeNote "Used as the object of intro:R19_hasType to qualify instances of intro:INT31_IntertextualRelation as Genettian hypertextual relations."@en,
            "Utilizzato come oggetto di intro:R19_hasType per qualificare istanze di intro:INT31_IntertextualRelation come relazioni ipertestuali genettiane."@it .
}

<https://w3id.org/desmos/hypertextuality> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> "Hypertextuality"@en <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
<https://w3id.org/desmos/hypertextuality> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#isDefinedBy> <https://w3id.org/desmos/> <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
<https://w3id.org/desmos/hypertextuality> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#prefLabel> "Ipertestualità"@it <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
<https://w3id.org/desmos/hypertextuality> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Type of intertextual relation, in the Genettian sense, designating any relationship of derivation linking a later text (the hypertext) to an earlier one (the hypotext) upon which it is grafted in a manner that is not that of commentary; the derivation may proceed by transformation (as in parody) or by imitation (as in pastiche)."@en <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
<https://w3id.org/desmos/hypertextuality> <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <https://w3id.org/lso/intro/beta202506#INT15_IntertextualityInIntertextualityTheories> <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
<https://w3id.org/desmos/hypertextuality> <http://purl.org/dc/terms/source> <https://www.worldcat.org/isbn/9782020061162> <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
<https://w3id.org/desmos/hypertextuality> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#scopeNote> "Utilizzato come oggetto di intro:R19_hasType per qualificare istanze di intro:INT31_IntertextualRelation come relazioni ipertestuali genettiane."@it <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
<https://w3id.org/desmos/hypertextuality> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#prefLabel> "Hypertextuality"@en <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
<https://w3id.org/desmos/hypertextuality> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Tipo di relazione intertestuale, nell'accezione genettiana, che designa qualsiasi rapporto di derivazione che collega un testo posteriore (l'ipertesto) ad un testo anteriore (l'ipotesto) sul quale esso si innesta in modo non commentativo; la derivazione può realizzarsi per trasformazione (come nella parodia) o per imitazione (come nel pastiche)."@it <https://w3id.org/desmos/> .
